text: Tired . I don’t want to get out of bed right now . It’s a weekend , but I have things that need to be done , and I’d rather just lounge in bed and sleep all day . I won’t , but I’d like to .    This has been a hard , grueling week , and I’m depressed .   I would rather escape into sleep , as I don’t feel when I’m asleep .   I have responsibilities , but they can wait for the moment .

I feel very sluggish and depressed .   There is a lot of conflict around me in my friend circle , and I really don’t like conflict . I don’t like having to take sides .   I want everyone around me to be friends .

I’m very sluggish this morning .   I don’t want to go anywhere or do anything . I will try to push myself and do chores today , but my mood is terrible . I have home repairs to make today and I should go to the ATM .   There is nothing I want to do .

I taking a break and doing something for fun . It is nice not to have to do anything for a bit . This is a good movie too , Strays . I should take more moments like this ; it might be good for me . I also watched some documentaries earlier today and might rewatch Borat .

Annoyed . I have a charge on my building account with no explanation . I locked myself out of my apartment . And I haven’t had a moment’s peace all damn day . The new hire calls every 10 minutes and won’t leave me   alone .

I am all nervous .   I just took a test , but I won ' t transcribe and turn it in because I know it ' s not a pass .   I ' m all worried about the election and scared of checking election results .   They were bad the last time I looked , even though I know we won ' t know for a few days yet .

Uh , the election was yesterday .   We’re stuck with the disaster of PERSON  for another 4 years or until his brain burns out , whichever is soonest . This is the worst possible thing that could happen .

I’m still grieving the election . I want to know what’s going on in the world , but I don’t want to know what’s going on in the world . I do not want to engage with anyone . I want to box myself in my apartment and never leave .

It will always be after the election . I am in the office and it is pointless for me to be here . I could be being productive at home . I am upset that I have to come into the office for no good reason .
